verdict.rationale: Luma's legacy Dream Machine API reference embeds per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 JSON definitions in the .md mirror of each reference page, so machine-readable spec content exists in first-party docs. There is no standalone downloadable spec file: probes of openapi.json, openapi.yaml and swagger.json all return 404, and that docs generation is bannered as legacy. Missing for 10: a single downloadable OpenAPI file, a spec for the current Luma Agents API, and independent corroboration of spec usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
